newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australis merger set, shrs issued at 25 cts.
newsitem.headline: Australis merger set, shrs issued at 25 cts.

text.p: Australis Media Ltd said on Tuesday it had agreed to the final terms for a merger with Foxtel, News Corp Ltd and Telstra Corp's pay television joint venture.
On completion of the deal, News Corp and Telstra would be issued with about 830 million shares each at an issue price of 25 cents per share, Australis said.
Australis' shares were up two cents at 23 cents by 10.20 p.m. (0020 GMT).

Australis, News and Telstra announced the merger on July 25 and said that after the completion of the deal, structured as a reverse takeover of Foxtel, News and Telstra would own up to 66.5 percent of Australis.
Australis said that all due diligence investigations had been completed and a Pay TV Merger Agreement was entered into August 18.

"In conjunction with the signing of the 1997 Pay TV Merger Agreement, News Corporation and Telstra Corporation prepaid in excess of A$16 million of licence fees under the existing heads of agreement on 18 August," Australis said.
